CREATE TABLE "public"."Account" (
  "access_token" text,
  "expires_at" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "id_token" text,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "scope" text,
  "session_state" text,
  "token_type" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Account_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AstronomySnapshot" (
  "dateString" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "fetchedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "illumination" float8,
  "locationId" text NOT NULL,
  "moonPhase" float8,
  "moonrise" text,
  "moonset" text,
  "phaseName" text,
  "solarNoon" text,
  "sunrise" text NOT NULL,
  "sunriseBlueEnd" text,
  "sunriseBlueStart" text,
  "sunriseGoldenEnd" text,
  "sunriseGoldenStart" text,
  "sunset" text NOT NULL,
  "sunsetBlueEnd" text,
  "sunsetBlueStart" text,
  "sunsetGoldenEnd" text,
  "sunsetGoldenStart" text,
  CONSTRAINT "AstronomySnapshot_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DbTableStats" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "indexBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "rowEstimate" int4 NOT NULL,
  "snapshotDate" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "tableBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tableName" text NOT NULL,
  "toastBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "totalBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "DbTableStats_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EphemerisDebug" (
  "createdAt" text,
  "date" text,
  "fetchedAt" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text,
  "moonPhase" float8,
  "moonrise" text,
  "moonset" text,
  "raw" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "receivedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "sunrise" text,
  "sunriseBlueEnd" text,
  "sunriseBlueStart" text,
  "sunriseGoldenEnd" text,
  "sunriseGoldenStart" text,
  "sunset" text,
  "sunsetBlueEnd" text,
  "sunsetBlueStart" text,
  "sunsetGoldenEnd" text,
  "sunsetGoldenStart" text,
  CONSTRAINT "EphemerisDebug_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ForecastSnapshot" (
  "fetchedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "ForecastSnapshot_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."GithubEvent" (
  "actor" text,
  "commitMessage" text,
  "commitSha" text,
  "conclusion" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobName" text,
  "raw" jsonb,
  "repo" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text,
  "title" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  CONSTRAINT "GithubEvent_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Location" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isDefault" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Location_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Log" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "domain" text NOT NULL,
  "file" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "level" text NOT NULL,
  "line" int4,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "meta" jsonb,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "requestId" text,
  "sessionEmail" text,
  "sessionUser" text,
  "userId" text,
  CONSTRAINT "Log_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Note" (
  "color" text,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "followUpAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isArchived" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isCompleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "pinned" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "tags" text[] DEFAULT '{}',
  "title" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userEmail" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Note_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RuntimeConfig" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RuntimeConfig_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Session" (
  "expires" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionToken" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Session_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ToolVersion" (
  "added_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "verified_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "version" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "ToolVersion_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TravelSegment" (
  "arrivalAirport" text NOT NULL,
  "arrivalCity" text NOT NULL,
  "arrivalTime" text NOT NULL,
  "cabin" text,
  "date" text NOT NULL,
  "departureAirport" text NOT NULL,
  "departureCity" text NOT NULL,
  "departureTime" text NOT NULL,
  "fareClass" text,
  "flightNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "marketedAs" text,
  "operatedBy" text,
  "seats" text[],
  "snapshotId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "TravelSegment_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TravelSnapshot" (
  "bags" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "confirmationCode" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "issuedDate" text NOT NULL,
  "passengers" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "payment" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "rawHtml" text NOT NULL,
  "receivedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "TravelSnapshot_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "email" text,
  "emailVerified" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "name" text,
  CONSTRAINT "User_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserRole" (
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "UserRole_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("email")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."VerificationToken" (
  "expires" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WeatherSnapshot" (
  "feelsLike" float8,
  "fetchedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "humidity" float8,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text NOT NULL,
  "pressure" float8,
  "temperature" float8 NOT NULL,
  "visibility" float8,
  "weatherCode" int4,
  "windDirection" float8,
  "windSpeed" float8,
  CONSTRAINT "WeatherSnapshot_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "verification_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
